t: You're looking at a bust of Patrick Blackett by Jacob Epstein. Blackett was a British experimental physicist who received the 1948 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 1925 he was the first person to prove that radioactivity could cause one chemical element to change into another, and in the Second World War he advised on military strategy and developed operational research. The sculptor, Sir Jacob Epstein, was born in the United States, moved to Europe in 1902, and became a British subject in 1910. He helped pioneer modern sculpture.
